scripts.build: npm run build -w @philoxenia/shared && npm run build -w @philoxenia/api && npm run build -w @philoxenia/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @philoxenia/api && npm run test:contracts
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @philoxenia/web && npm run lint -w @philoxenia/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @philoxenia/web && npm run typecheck -w @philoxenia/api && npm run typecheck -w @philoxenia/shared
